title: Compliance Disclosure Ojk Conduct
content: Compliance Disclosure Ojk Conduct: Petugas penagihan dilarang mengancam, mempermalukan, atau menggunakan kata-kata kasar kepada nasabah dalam bentuk apa pun, baik secara langsung maupun tersirat. Petugas dilarang mengungkapkan informasi tunggakan atau utang nasabah kepada pihak ketiga yang tidak berwenang, termasuk keluarga, tetangga, rekan kerja, atau atasan nasabah. Penagihan hanya boleh dilakukan pada pukul 08.00 sampai 20.00 waktu setempat nasabah, dan tidak boleh dilakukan pada hari libur nasional kecuali disetujui oleh nasabah. Setiap petugas penagihan wajib menyebutkan identitas resmi dan nama perusahaan pembiayaan sebelum memulai proses penagihan.

title: Compliance Disclosure Ojk Conduct (cont.)
content: Compliance Disclosure Ojk Conduct: Jika nasabah menyatakan keberatan atau meminta penagihan dihentikan untuk sementara, petugas wajib mencatat permintaan tersebut dan mengeskalasi ke supervisor, bukan melanjutkan penagihan secara paksa.

title: Compliance Disclosure Requirements
content: Compliance Disclosure Requirements: Agents must state the free-look period of 15 days before the customer confirms purchase, during which the policy can be cancelled for a full refund minus a small administrative charge. Agents must disclose that this is an insurance product and not a fixed deposit or guaranteed-return investment before discussing any premium. Agents must confirm the customer has read and understood the waiting period and pre existing disease exclusions before closing the sale.

title: Eligibility Qualification Life Insurance
content: Eligibility Qualification Life Insurance: Ang aplikante po ay dapat na may edad na 18 hanggang 65 taon sa oras ng aplikasyon para sa bagong policy.

title: Eligibility Qualification Life Insurance (cont.)
content: Eligibility Qualification Life Insurance: Kinakailangan po ang kumpletong health declaration; ang pagtatago ng impormasyon tungkol sa dating o kasalukuyang kondisyong medikal ay maaaring maging dahilan ng pagtanggi ng claim sa hinaharap.

title: Eligibility Qualification Life Insurance (cont.)
content: Eligibility Qualification Life Insurance: Ang mga aplikante na may sum assured na higit sa ₱2,000,000 ay maaaring kailanganin ng medical exam bago aprubahan ang aplikasyon.

title: Eligibility Qualification Life Insurance (cont.)
content: Eligibility Qualification Life Insurance: Ang mga customer na na-refer ng partner bank ay maaaring magkaroon ng mas mabilis na proseso kung kasalukuyan silang may savings o current account sa nasabing bangko.

title: Process Installment Payment Options
content: Process Installment Payment Options — Cara Bayar Angsuran: Pembayaran angsuran dapat dilakukan melalui transfer bank, auto-debit rekening, virtual account, atau merchant retail seperti Alfamart dan Indomaret. Setiap metode akan terverifikasi dalam waktu 1 sampai 2 hari kerja.

title: Process Installment Payment Options (cont.)
content: Process Installment Payment Options — Cara Aktifkan Auto-Debit: Auto-debit akan otomatis memotong angsuran dari rekening Bapak/Ibu setiap tanggal jatuh tempo, sehingga tidak perlu khawatir lupa bayar. Pengajuan dapat dilakukan dengan mengisi formulir auto-debit di cabang atau melalui aplikasi.

title: Process Installment Payment Options (cont.)
content: Process Installment Payment Options — Jika Terjadi Tunggakan: Jika terjadi keterlambatan pembayaran melebihi jatuh tempo, akan dikenakan denda sesuai perjanjian pembiayaan. Jika tunggakan berlanjut, nasabah akan dihubungi untuk mendiskusikan opsi pembayaran, termasuk kemungkinan restrukturisasi jika memenuhi syarat.

title: Eligibility Qualification Pembiayaan
content: Eligibility Qualification Pembiayaan: Nasabah harus berusia minimal 21 tahun atau sudah menikah pada saat pengajuan pembiayaan baru.

title: Eligibility Qualification Pembiayaan (cont.)
content: Eligibility Qualification Pembiayaan: Riwayat pembayaran angsuran minimal 6 bulan berjalan lancar diperlukan untuk pengajuan top-up pembiayaan.

title: Eligibility Qualification Pembiayaan (cont.)
content: Eligibility Qualification Pembiayaan: Pengajuan restrukturisasi tenor akan dievaluasi berdasarkan riwayat pembayaran dan alasan keterlambatan yang disampaikan nasabah.

title: Eligibility Qualification Pembiayaan (cont.)
content: Eligibility Qualification Pembiayaan: Nasabah dengan tunggakan lebih dari 90 hari tidak dapat mengajukan pembiayaan atau top-up baru sampai tunggakan diselesaikan.

title: Faq Life Insurance Premium
content: Faq Life Insurance Premium: Q: Kailan po ang due date ng aking premium? A: Ang premium po ay dapat bayaran nang buo bago ang due date na nakalagay sa inyong policy schedule, halimbawa ika-15 ng Marso. May 31 araw pong grace period pagkatapos ng due date bago mag-lapse ang coverage.

title: Faq Life Insurance Premium (cont.)
content: Faq Life Insurance Premium: Q: Ano po ang mangyayari kung ma-late ako sa bayad? A: Kung lumampas po sa 31 araw na grace period ang hindi pagbabayad, maaaring mag-lapse ang inyong policy, ibig sabihin ay mawawalan po ng bisa ang coverage. Kailangan pong mag-reinstate at maaaring may karagdagang requirement bago maibalik ang coverage.

title: Faq Life Insurance Premium (cont.)
content: Faq Life Insurance Premium: Q: Pwede po bang palitan ang aking beneficiary? A: Opo, pwede pong palitan ang beneficiary anumang oras sa pamamagitan ng pagsumite ng beneficiary change form sa aming branch o sa inyong bank referral officer kung sa bank kayo nag-apply ng policy.

title: Faq Life Insurance Premium (cont.)
content: Faq Life Insurance Premium: Q: Ano po ang rider na maidadagdag ko sa aking policy? A: Available po ang accidental death rider at critical illness rider na maidadagdag sa inyong base coverage, karaniwan po nang may karagdagang premium na nagsisimula sa ₱200 kada buwan depende sa edad at sum assured.

title: Faq Life Insurance Premium (cont.)
content: Faq Life Insurance Premium: Q: Paano ko malalaman kung magkano ang aking sum assured? A: Makikita po ang inyong sum assured sa inyong policy contract o sa policy summary na ipinadala noong nag-apply kayo. Maaari rin po kaming magpadala ng kopya sa inyong email kung kailangan ninyo.

title: Objection Handling Premium Reminder
content: Objection Handling Premium Reminder: Objection: Wala akong pera ngayon. Response: Naiintindihan po namin. Meron po kaming auto-debit facility na pwede ninyong i-set sa araw na may sahod kayo, para hindi na po kayo mag-alala sa due date. Gusto niyo po bang i-set up natin ito ngayon, o mas gugustuhin niyo po bang tawagan namin kayo sa ibang araw?

title: Objection Handling Premium Reminder (cont.)
content: Objection Handling Premium Reminder: Objection: Kailangan ko munang kausapin ang asawa ko. Response: Naiintindihan po namin, importante po talaga na mapag-usapan ninyo ito. Gusto niyo po bang tumawag ulit kami sa susunod na araw, o mas gugustuhin niyo pong magpadala kami ng detalye sa email o SMS para mabasa rin ng inyong asawa?

title: Objection Handling Premium Reminder (cont.)
content: Objection Handling Premium Reminder: Objection: Scam ba ito? Response: Naiintindihan po namin ang alalahanin ninyo, tama pong mag-ingat. Opisyal po kaming tumatawag bilang kinatawan ng inyong insurance provider, at makikita ninyo ang aming opisyal na numero sa likod ng inyong policy card o sa aming website. Maaari po kayong tumawag gamit ang numerong iyon para makumpirma ang tawag na ito bago magbigay ng anumang detalye.

title: Objection Handling Premium Reminder (cont.)
content: Objection Handling Premium Reminder: Objection: May insurance na ako sa work. Response: Maganda po iyon! Karamihan po ng group insurance sa trabaho ay tumatagal lamang habang kayo ay empleyado roon. Ang inyong individual policy po ay nagpapatuloy nang independiyente kahit magpalit kayo ng trabaho. Gusto niyo po bang malaman kung paano ito nagko-complement sa inyong coverage sa work?

title: Branch Partnership Benefits
content: Branch Partnership Benefits: Operational, marketing, and technology support is provided to branch partners. Branch partners receive a dedicated relationship manager and quarterly performance reviews. The sum assured for group health products offered through branch partners starts at INR 500,000 and can go up to INR 5,000,000 depending on the qualification rules effective from 2023-04-01. For support, contact our partnership desk. Sample contact on file: Ramesh Kumar, [EMAIL], [PHONE].

title: Compliance Disclosure Requirements
content: Compliance Disclosure Requirements: Dapat ipaalam sa customer sa simula ng tawag na ito po ay nire-record para sa quality assurance at training purposes. Dapat munang kumpirmahin ang pagkakakilanlan ng customer, tulad ng buong pangalan at petsa ng kapanganakan o policy number, bago talakayin ang anumang detalye ng kanilang policy. Bawal pong ibahagi ang detalye ng policy, halaga ng premium, o katayuan ng bayad sa ibang tao maliban sa may-ari mismo ng account o sa awtorisadong kinatawan nito, alinsunod sa Data Privacy Act. Kung tatanggihan po ng customer na tumuloy sa tawag o magbigay ng karagdagang impormasyon, dapat itong respetuhin at wakasan nang maayos ang tawag.

title: Health Insurance Faq
content: Health Insurance Faq: Q: What is the waiting period for pre existing disease cover? A: The waiting period for pre existing disease claims is 24 months from the policy start date of 2023-04-01.

title: Health Insurance Faq (cont.)
content: Health Insurance Faq: Q: I already have a claim rejected elsewhere, will you still cover me? A: Coverage eligibility depends on full disclosure of pre existing disease history at the time of proposal.

title: Health Insurance Faq (cont.)
content: Health Insurance Faq: Q: Can I add my spouse and children to the same policy? A: Yes, spouse and dependent children up to 25 years old can be added as family members on the same floater policy.

title: Product Bank Referral Bancassurance
content: Product Bank Referral Bancassurance: Ang aming bank referral program po ay nagbibigay-daan sa mga customer ng aming partner banks na ma-access nang direkta ang mga life insurance product namin sa pamamagitan ng kanilang bangko. Kasama po rito ang mga karagdagang proteksyon tulad ng accidental death rider at critical illness rider. Ang mga customer na na-refer po sa amin ng bangko ay maaaring mag-enjoy ng mas mabilis na proseso ng application dahil ang ilang detalye po ay nakukuha na mula sa kanilang existing bank relationship. Ang sum assured po ay nagsisimula sa ₱500,000 at maaaring umabot hanggang ₱10,000,000 depende sa edad, kalusugan, at kakayahang magbayad ng premium.

title: Objection Handling -- Health Insurance
content: Objection Handling -- Health Insurance: Objection: Your premium is higher than what competitors quote for a similar sum assured. Response: Our sum assured includes cashless hospitalization across 10,000-plus network hospitals and a no-claim bonus that increases cover by 10 percent each claim-free year, which most competitor quotes at this price tier do not include.

title: Objection Handling -- Health Insurance (cont.)
content: Objection Handling -- Health Insurance: Objection: I already have health coverage through my employer, so I do not need my own policy. Response: Employer-provided cover usually ends when employment ends; an individual policy continues independently and is not affected by a job change.

title: Objection Handling -- Health Insurance (cont.)
content: Objection Handling -- Health Insurance: Objection: I am worried pre-existing conditions will not be covered at all. Response: Pre-existing conditions are covered after the waiting period of 24 months from the policy start date, as long as they were disclosed at proposal.

title: Eligibility and Qualification Rules
content: Eligibility and Qualification Rules: Applicant must be between 18 and 65 years old at the time of proposal.

title: Eligibility and Qualification Rules (cont.)
content: Eligibility and Qualification Rules: No declined or repudiated claims with any insurer in the last 3 years.

title: Eligibility and Qualification Rules (cont.)
content: Eligibility and Qualification Rules: Sum assured requested above INR 2,000,000 requires a pre-policy medical checkup.

title: Eligibility and Qualification Rules (cont.)
content: Eligibility and Qualification Rules: Pre existing disease history must be fully disclosed at proposal stage; non-disclosure can void a claim.

title: Process Premium Payment Options
content: Process Premium Payment Options — Paraan ng Pagbabayad: Maaari pong magbayad ng premium sa pamamagitan ng: bank transfer, auto-debit sa savings account, over-the-counter sa mga partner bank, o sa pamamagitan ng GCash o PayMaya. Ang bawat pamamaraan po ay kinukumpirma agad sa loob ng 1 hanggang 2 araw ng trabaho.

title: Process Premium Payment Options (cont.)
content: Process Premium Payment Options — Pag-set Up ng Auto-Debit: Ang auto-debit po ay awtomatikong magbabawas ng premium sa inyong bank account tuwing due date, kaya hindi na po ninyo kailangang alalahanin ang pagbabayad kada buwan. Maiiwasan din po nito ang posibilidad ng lapse ng inyong policy dahil sa nakalimutang pagbabayad. Maaari pong i-set up ito sa pamamagitan ng pagsumite ng auto-debit authorization form sa inyong bank o sa amin.

title: Process Premium Payment Options (cont.)
content: Process Premium Payment Options — Kung Nag-lapse na ang Policy: Kung nag-lapse na po ang inyong policy dahil sa hindi pagbabayad lampas sa grace period, kailangan pong mag-file ng reinstatement request sa loob ng 2 taon mula sa petsa ng lapse. Maaaring may karagdagang health declaration o medical exam na kailangan depende sa haba ng panahong hindi nabayaran ang premium.

title: Faq Multifinance Installment
content: Faq Multifinance Installment: Q: Kapan jatuh tempo cicilan saya? A: Cicilan Bapak/Ibu jatuh tempo setiap tanggal 25 setiap bulannya, sesuai dengan perjanjian pembiayaan yang telah disepakati. Pembayaran dapat dilakukan mulai H-3 sebelum tanggal jatuh tempo.

title: Faq Multifinance Installment (cont.)
content: Faq Multifinance Installment: Q: Berapa denda kalau telat bayar angsuran? A: Denda keterlambatan adalah 0,5% per hari dari jumlah angsuran yang tertunggak, dengan maksimal denda sesuai ketentuan yang berlaku dan perjanjian pembiayaan.

title: Faq Multifinance Installment (cont.)
content: Faq Multifinance Installment: Q: Bisa nggak tenornya diperpanjang? A: Bisa Pak/Bu, perpanjangan tenor melalui restrukturisasi dapat diajukan dengan menghubungi cabang terdekat atau customer service, dan akan dievaluasi berdasarkan riwayat pembayaran Bapak/Ibu.

title: Faq Multifinance Installment (cont.)
content: Faq Multifinance Installment: Q: Berapa DP minimal untuk pembiayaan kendaraan? A: DP minimal umumnya 20 persen dari harga kendaraan untuk kendaraan baru, dan bisa berbeda untuk kendaraan bekas tergantung penilaian dan kebijakan pembiayaan.

title: Faq Multifinance Installment (cont.)
content: Faq Multifinance Installment: Q: Apakah bisa top-up pembiayaan yang sedang berjalan? A: Bisa, top-up dapat diajukan setelah minimal 6 bulan angsuran berjalan lancar tanpa tunggakan, dengan limit tambahan yang akan dievaluasi berdasarkan kemampuan bayar.

title: Objection Handling Collections
content: Objection Handling Collections: Objection: Gajian belum masuk. Response: Baik Pak/Bu, kami mengerti. Boleh kami tahu perkiraan tanggal gajian Bapak/Ibu supaya kami bisa catat janji bayarnya, dan kami akan hubungi kembali sesuai tanggal tersebut?

title: Objection Handling Collections (cont.)
content: Objection Handling Collections: Objection: Dendanya kok besar? Response: Kami mengerti kekhawatiran Bapak/Ibu. Denda dihitung sesuai perjanjian pembiayaan di awal, dan kami bisa bantu jelaskan rinciannya atau bantu ajukan keringanan denda jika Bapak/Ibu memenuhi syarat.

title: Objection Handling Collections (cont.)
content: Objection Handling Collections: Objection: Saya udah bayar kemarin. Response: Baik, mohon maaf atas ketidaknyamanannya. Boleh kami minta bukti transfer atau nomor referensi pembayarannya supaya bisa kami verifikasi ke sistem kami?

title: Objection Handling Collections (cont.)
content: Objection Handling Collections: Objection: Bisa diperpanjang tenornya? Response: Bisa Pak/Bu, perpanjangan tenor melalui restrukturisasi dapat diajukan dengan menghubungi cabang terdekat, dan akan dievaluasi berdasarkan riwayat pembayaran Bapak/Ibu.

title: Claim Filing Process
content: Claim Filing Process — Step 1: Notify the Claims Desk: Notify the claims desk within 48 hours of hospital admission for a planned procedure, or within 24 hours of admission for an emergency, by calling the claims helpline or submitting the online claim form.

title: Claim Filing Process (cont.)
content: Claim Filing Process — Step 2: Submit Documents: Submit the hospital discharge summary, itemized final bill, and all diagnostic reports within 15 days of discharge. Incomplete document sets are the most common cause of claim delay.

title: Claim Filing Process (cont.)
content: Claim Filing Process — Step 3: Settlement: Cashless claims at network hospitals are typically settled directly with the hospital within 2 to 4 hours of document submission; reimbursement claims at non-network hospitals are settled within 15 working days of receiving a complete document set.
